values.note: 2026: water/electric 30-amp pull-through $48 a night ($288 weekly, $750 for 28 days), 50-amp back-in $53 ($318 weekly, $800 for 28 days). Rates cover 2 adults and 3 children; each extra person $5 a day. Cancellation 14+ days out refunded minus $25.

fees.source: https://geneseecountrycampground.com/rates/ ('2026 Season Open: May 1 to October 12'; 'Standard W / E (30amp pull thru) $ 48 /nightly', '$ 288 /weekly', '$ 750 /monthly (28 days)'; 'Standard W / E (50amp back in) $ 53 /nightly'; 'Camping rates are based on 2 adults and 3 children (under 18) Additional occupants will be at a charge of $5.00 per day / per person.'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Online through ParkWith (parkwith.us); call the park if the search shows no online availability. Monthly and seasonal stays are booked by contacting the campground. Holiday weekends (Memorial Day, Labor Day) need 3 nights and cannot be cancelled or changed.

booking.source: https://geneseecountrycampground.com/rates/ ('If your reservation search results in No Online Availability, please contact the Park'; 'Monthly and Seasonal Stays must be booked by contacting the campground directly'; 'Holidays Require a 3 Night Minimum Stay: Memorial Day Weekend (May 22 - 25, 2026) Labor Day (September 4 - 7, 2026)') + home page 'Online Reservations' -> https://parkwith.us/camps/genesee-country-campground, read 2026-10-21

season.source: https://geneseecountrycampground.com/rates/ ('2026 Season Open: May 1 to October 12'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 30-amp pull-through buddy sites and 50-amp back-in sites, both with water and gray-water discharge.

hookups.source: https://geneseecountrycampground.com/facilities/ ('RV Sites: 30amp electric, water & gray water discharge. Pull Thru buddy sites / 50amp electric, water & gray water discharge. Back In sites.'), read 2026-10-21
